name: Cao Zhi
contribution: A prince of the state of Cao Wei in the Three Kingdoms period of China, and an accomplished poet in his time.

checks.lead: Cao Zhi (; Chinese: 曹植; 192 – 27 December 232), courtesy name Zijian (Chinese: 子建), posthumously known as Prince Si of Chen (陈思王), was a prince of the state of Cao Wei in the Three Kingdoms period of China, and an accomplished poet in his time. His style of poetry, greatly revered during the Jin dynasty and Southern and Northern Dynasties, came to be known as the Jian'an style.
